features: 60W Type C to Type C Fast Charging Cable: Delivers high-speed 60W PD output for rapid charging of smartphones, tablets, and other Type C devices.
USB Keychain Design: Compact, always-with-you cable that clips onto your keys, bag, or wallet, never get caught without a charger again.
Detachable Lanyard Tag with Phone Case Hook: Comes with a removable lanyard attachment that hooks onto phone cases, offering flexible carry options on the go.
Metal Alloy Connector Shell: Sturdy metal-alloy build at the connector ends adds durability and everyday wear resistance.
Braided Nylon Cable: Tangle-free braided nylon construction resists fraying and stretching, built to last through daily use.
30CM Compact Length: Short, travel-friendly length that's easy to carry without the bulk of a full-size cable.
Fast Data Sync Support: Supports quick data transfer alongside charging, so you can sync files on the move.
Universal Type C Compatibility: Works seamlessly with smartphones, tablets, earbuds cases, and other Type C-enabled devices.
description: The Portronics KeyLink C is a 60W Type C to Type C keychain cable designed for everyday convenience and on-the-go charging. Compact and portable at just 30CM, it clips easily onto your keys or bag with its detachable lanyard tag that also hooks onto phone cases, so it's always within reach. The braided nylon build resists tangling and wear, while the metal alloy connector shell adds durability for daily use. With 60W fast charging support and reliable data sync, the KeyLink C ensures you're never without power: a compact, reliable charging companion built for life on the move.
